yanbu.title: Pipa Timur–Barat (4–5 juta barel/hari) ditutup sementara; penutupan menyangkut hingga 5% pasokan minyak dunia.
yanbu.title_en: The East-West pipeline (4–5 million bpd) was shut temporarily, affecting up to 5% of world oil supply.

yanbu.title: Arab Saudi menutup pipa setelah serangan drone; Baghdad menyatakan serangan berasal dari wilayah Irak.
yanbu.title_en: Saudi Arabia shut the pipeline after a drone attack; Baghdad confirmed the strike came from Iraqi territory.

bab.title: Enam orang tewas dalam serangan rudal Houthi ke kapal kargo Tihamah di Bab el-Mandeb, korban jiwa pelayaran niaga pertama sejak perang Iran.
bab.title_en: Six people were killed in a Houthi missile strike on the cargo ship Tihamah in Bab el-Mandeb, the first merchant-shipping deaths since the Iran war began.

saratov.title: Drone Ukraina menghantam kilang besar sekitar 1.300 km dari perbatasan, serangan keempat dalam tiga hari; Rusia mengalami kelangkaan BBM.
saratov.title_en: Ukrainian drones hit a major refinery about 1,300 km from the border, the fourth strike in three days; Russia faces fuel shortages.

novo.title: Terminal KSK ikut berhenti, sehingga ketiga terminal gandum Novorossiysk tutup. Ekspor gandum laut Rusia Juli turun 20,3% dari tahun lalu.
novo.title_en: KSK also halted, so all three Novorossiysk grain terminals are shut. Russian seaborne grain exports fell 20.3% year on year in July.

novo.title: Dua terminal gandum besar berhenti setelah serangan drone; harga gandum Chicago naik sekitar 3%.
novo.title_en: Two big grain terminals halted after drone strikes; Chicago wheat rose about 3%.

donbas.title: Rusia menyerang fasilitas energi di wilayah Odesa; Ukraina mengklaim menghantam kilang di Rusia selatan dan Tatarstan.
donbas.title_en: Russia hit energy sites in the Odesa region; Ukraine claimed strikes on refineries in southern Russia and Tatarstan.

kalin.title: Rusia memperingatkan NATO akan memakai seluruh persenjataan, termasuk nuklir, bila Kaliningrad diisolasi. NATO menyangkal merencanakan blokade.
kalin.title_en: Russia warned NATO it would use its full arsenal, including nuclear weapons, if Kaliningrad is cut off. NATO denied planning a blockade.
